title: AgentsDeck manifest
description: Describes agents, skills and MCP servers for AgentsDeck, for any platform it has no adapter for, including cloud agents. See https://github.com/Hirukadeven07/AgentsDeck/blob/main/docs/manifest.md

version.description: The manifest format version. Only 1 exists.

mcpServers.description: Names of MCP servers the agents can use.

id.description: Unique within the manifest. Skills and agents refer to agents by id.

name.description: Shown in AgentsDeck. Defaults to the id.

kind.description: primary: the agent that runs by default. custom: one you defined.

description.description: What the agent does and when to use it.

model.description: The model it runs on, such as claude-opus-5-5.

provider.description: Where it runs, such as Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI or n8n. Shown with the description.

instructions.description: The skill's instructions, such as the body of its SKILL.md.
